summary: @servicetitan/standalone-tm-api ships obfuscated preinstall dropper that downloads Bun and executes a 727KB obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs is itself obfuscated (hex identifier names, string-dictionary indirection) and, on npm install, detects host platform/arch (including musl via /etc/os-release), constructs a URL of the form https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<V>/<platform>.zip, downloads and extracts the Bun runtime, chmods the binary executable, and runs execFileSync(bunPath, ["math_init.js"]). math_init.js is a 727,680-byte single-line file tagged "// @bun @bun-cjs" containing heavily obfuscated code (WV8StW rotating string-array, hex identifier names, large integer/string constant table). Neither the README nor CHANGELOG document this payload; the package's stated purpose is an NSwag-generated tenant-management API client (dist/api/*), which has no need for a second language runtime or a 727KB opaque bundle. Installing the package causes an obfuscated payload to execute under a freshly-dropped Bun runtime, on the installer's machine, with the installer's privileges.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
